system.text:
The mouth of an Orc is a violent organ, well suited to tearing flesh and shouting blasphemies. Orcs may use their Fanged Maw as a weapon: The bite is a Power 1, WS 1, VA 1, Add 2, shortest length weapon. Claws like steel shards protrude from their gnarled fingers. They may be used as weapons: Power 1, WS X, VA –, Add 2, short length.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Orc common trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 325
